svg.aria-label: The lag between capability and legal response
svg.title: The lag between capability and legal response
svg.desc: Hexagon: capability milestone. Circle: treaty. Square: resolution or body finding (non-binding). Triangle: unilateral pledge. Open ring: no binding rule yet.
svg.text: The lag between capability and legal response

svg.desc: Dumbbell chart: for each pair, a hexagon marks the capability milestone and a shape marks the legal or policy response (circle for treaty, square for a resolution or body finding, triangle for a unilateral pledge). The gap is the lag in years. An open ring means no binding rule yet.

g.aria-label: First DA-ASAT flyby → Outer Space Treaty (silent on conventional ASATs). 7.3 years.
g.text: First DA-ASAT flyby → Outer Space Treaty (silent on conventional ASATs)

g.aria-label: Starfish Prime → Limited Test Ban Treaty (followed it). 1.1 years.
g.text: Starfish Prime → Limited Test Ban Treaty (followed it)

g.aria-label: Fengyun-1C debris → UNGA 77/41 call to stop destructive tests (non-binding). 15.9 years.
g.text: Fengyun-1C debris → UNGA 77/41 call to stop destructive tests (non-binding)

g.aria-label: Cosmos 1408 → US test moratorium (unilateral pledge). 5 months.
Russian GNSS interference (from 2014) → first ICAO finding against Russia. 11.6 years.
g.text: Russian GNSS interference (from 2014) → first ICAO finding against Russia

g.aria-label: Jamming of European satellites → ITU RRB “grave concern”. 4 months.
g.text: Jamming of European satellites → ITU RRB “grave concern”

g.aria-label: Laser fired at a satellite → no specific rule on lasers against satellites. No binding response yet.
g.text: Laser fired at a satellite → no specific rule on lasers against satellites

g.aria-label: Viasat cyberattack → attributions only; Tallinn 2.0 is soft law. No binding response yet.
g.text: Viasat cyberattack → attributions only; Tallinn 2.0 is soft law

svg.text: Hexagon: capability milestone. Circle: treaty. Square: resolution or body finding (non-binding). Triangle: unilateral pledge. Open ring: no binding rule yet.

Source: Secure World Foundation, Global Counterspace Capabilities: An Open Source Assessment (9th ed., Apr. 2026) and the primary sources cited in the ledger. Data as of SWF 9th ed., Apr. 2026. Companion to
Space Security Law: Governance Beyond the Atmosphere.
